commands.summary: Plan and execute the approve deny affiliate reverse-ETL action
examples: pm uppromote approve deny affiliate apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: approves or denies a pending affiliate application; low-risk, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the approve deny referral reverse-ETL action
examples: pm uppromote approve deny referral apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: approves or denies a pending referral, affecting affiliate payout eligibility; no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the assign coupon to affiliate reverse-ETL action
examples: pm uppromote assign coupon to affiliate apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: assigns a discount coupon code to an affiliate for referral tracking; low-risk, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the connect customer to affiliate reverse-ETL action
examples: pm uppromote connect customer to affiliate apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: links a Shopify customer email to an affiliate for future referral attribution; low-risk, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Run the coupons ETL stream
examples: pm uppromote coupons list --json

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create affiliate reverse-ETL action
examples: pm uppromote create affiliate apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: creates a new affiliate account; low-risk, no approval required (UpPromote caps this at 150 affiliates/day per its own API)
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the create referral reverse-ETL action
examples: pm uppromote create referral apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: creates a manual commission-bearing referral for an affiliate, either tied to a Shopify order or as a fixed amount; affects payout totals, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the delete webhook subscription reverse-ETL action
examples: pm uppromote delete webhook subscription apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: removes a webhook subscription; the external endpoint stops receiving that event type, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.path: mark as paid manual payment apply
commands.summary: Plan and execute the mark as paid manual payment reverse-ETL action
examples: pm uppromote mark as paid manual payment apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: marks approved referrals as manually paid outside UpPromote's own payout processing; affects financial records, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the move affiliate to program reverse-ETL action
examples: pm uppromote move affiliate to program apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: reassigns an affiliate to a different commission program, changing future commission rules; no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Run the paid payments ETL stream
examples: pm uppromote paid payments list --json

commands.summary: Run the programs ETL stream
examples: pm uppromote programs list --json

commands.summary: Run the referrals ETL stream
examples: pm uppromote referrals list --json

commands.summary: Plan and execute the set upline affiliate reverse-ETL action

flags.name: upline_affiliate_email
flags.summary: Required upline affiliate email record field.

examples: pm uppromote set upline affiliate apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: sets the referring (upline) affiliate for a downline affiliate, affecting multi-tier commission attribution; no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Plan and execute the subscribe webhook event reverse-ETL action
examples: pm uppromote subscribe webhook event apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: registers a new outbound webhook subscription that will deliver event payloads to an external URL; low-risk, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute

commands.summary: Run the unpaid payments ETL stream
examples: pm uppromote unpaid payments list --json

commands.summary: Plan and execute the update webhook subscription reverse-ETL action
examples: pm uppromote update webhook subscription apply --plan <plan-name>
commands.risk: updates an existing webhook subscription's target URL; low-risk, no approval required
commands.approval: requires plan, preview, approval, and execute
